The binomial valuation bound for j>=3 in (I+2E)^{2^r} gives M^{7·2^r}=I+2^{r+1}H_r mod2^{r+2} and H_r≡H mod2 for all r>=1. Replacing the difference t-s with odd·2^j forces normalized F(t)=T_{1280+1792t}/512 to preserve every 2-adic distance; its extension to Z2 is a bijective isometry on all finite residue quotients and has a unique zero tau. Then ν2(T)=9+ν2(t-tau) for every nonnegative integer t. Checked independently root congruences through 2^18 (tau mod2^18=9928), base T1280 mod8192=4096 and modular lift. Samples do not substitute for the binomial/isometry argument.
